sourceNotes.rawContent: Pulse with style in this exquisite gold-toned Heartbeat Bracelet. Featuring a crystal-studded lifeline motif, this trendy piece adds a sentimental glow to any look. To maintain its radiant golden luster, keep it away from moisture and perfumes, and store it safely in a dry place after every wear.
